Veilwater Basin Dirt.note: Veilwater Basin Dirt is a terrain material found in the Veilwater Basin. It has four uses: Fertile Veilwater Basin Dirt at the Workbench, Veilwater Basin Rubble at the Grinding Stones, Wisteria at the Farmer and the Algae Seedling at the Seedbed.

Plant Fiber.note: Plant Fiber is gathered from bushes all over Embervale and also lies around as a loose pickup; bushes can be grown from Shrub Seedlings. Its 38 uses include the Big Straw Mat and Marksman Hood at the Hunter, the Wooden Bed and Ornate Wooden Bed at the Carpenter, Goat Food, the Cat Pillow and Sword Garden Gnome at the Farmer, and the Explosive Barrel.

Wood Logs.note: Wood Logs come from chopping down trees, with bigger trees giving more, and from breaking wooden objects. Twigs and Resin drop with them. Their 166 uses include stations such as the Forge, Loom, Kitchen, Seedbed and Table Saw, crude and carved wooden furniture, doors, fences and palisades, weapon racks and wall mounts, and weapons like the Club, Spiked Club and Wooden Shield.

Torn Cloth.note: Torn Cloth comes from drops rather than crafting, and it goes into 90 recipes. These include the Bandage, the Ragged, Fur, Mage, Magician and Alchemist Apprentice armor, and the Tiny Backpack made by hand. At the Ectoplasm Press it goes into Ectoplasm, Greater Ectoplasm and Excellent Ectoplasm, and it is also used for supply sacks, war banners, showcases and stone furniture.

Metal Scraps.note: Metal Scraps are a common drop from Scavengers, and they can also be salvaged from destroyed metal objects or picked up loose in the world. They go into Nails and Metal Sheets and 112 other recipes. Those include stations such as the Forge, Kiln and Cooking Station, the Scrappy tools, the Explorer armor set, scrap pots, vats and pans, crypt torches and the Grappling Hook.

Stone.note: Stone is picked up as small stones lying on the ground all over Embervale, Shroud included. Larger stones and rock formations in the Springlands and Revelwood can be mined with a pickaxe. Its 97 uses start with the Axe, made by hand, and the Pickaxe, and run through stations such as the Forge, Kiln, Mill, Charcoal Kiln and Grinding Stones to stone furniture, coffins, statues and building blocks.

Kindlewastes Flower.note: Kindlewastes Flower is harvested from the flowers of the same name in the Kindlewastes, and they can be grown from a Kindlewastes Flower Seedling, which is also made from this flower. Its other use is Spice at the Laboratory.

Shroud Adhesive.source: Shroud Flayer, First: Nomad Highlands Shroud

Revelwood Stone.note: Revelwood Stone is a terrain material that stacks to 1,000, with 1,867 placed in the world. It goes into nine recipes, including the Kiln, the Cooking Station and Revelwood Rubble at the Grinding Stones.

Resin.source: Trees, mainly stumps and red-leaved trees

Bones.note: Bones are a common drop from wildlife and Hollow across Embervale, and bone piles, including those in and around the Hollow Halls, can be mined for more. They feed 46 recipes, among them the Flute at the Bard, Scout Pants at the Hunter, the Reaper's Wand at the Alchemist, and crypt furniture and the Bone Arrow at the Collector.

Springlands Dirt.note: Springlands Dirt is a terrain material found in the Springlands. Its 18 uses include Farm Soil at the Farmer, Workbench blocks such as the Dirt Road Block, Field Stones and Limestone Block, Springlands Rubble, Goo and White Glowing Substance at the Alchemist, the Climbing Rose and the Crucible.

Blackmire Stone.note: Blackmire Stone is a Common terrain material with a stack size of 1,000.

Ammonia Gland.source: Fell Mushroom Crabs, Nomad Highlands Shroud and Kindlewastes Shroud

Critter Parts.source: Fell Enemies, Springlands Shroud and Revelwood Shroud

Revelwood Dirt.note: Revelwood Dirt is a terrain material found in the Revelwood. The Workbench uses it for Fertile Revelwood Dirt and Revelwood Stone, the Grinding Stones for Revelwood Rubble, and it also goes into the Antique and Flint colors.

Blackmire Dirt.note: Blackmire Dirt is a terrain material that stacks to 1,000. Its one crafting use is Fertile Blackmire Dirt, made at the Workbench.

Nomad Highlands Dirt.note: Nomad Highlands Dirt is a terrain material found in the Nomad Highlands. It has five uses: Fertile Nomad Highlands Dirt and the Castle Wall Stone Block at the Workbench, Nomad Highlands Rubble at the Grinding Stones, and the Deceit and Forgotten Library colors.

Albaneve Summits Dirt.note: Albaneve Summits Dirt is the Common terrain material dug up in the Albaneve Summits, stacking to 1,000.

Cinder's Cradle Dirt.note: Cinder's Cradle Dirt is a terrain material that stacks to 1,000. It is an ingredient of Cinder's Cradle Rubble at the Grinding Stones and of Fertile Cinder's Cradle Dirt and Fertile Altered Dirt at the Workbench.

Critter Carapace.source: Fell Enemies, Albaneve Summits Shroud and Veilwater Basin Shroud

Fur Patch.note: Fur Patch is a common drop from small wildlife such as rats and bats, found all over Embervale.
